author: Corridor Crew
description:
This year, Disney released three musical sequences from Frozen 2, Encanto, and Moana 2, reanimated to portray American Sign Language (ASL). 

Carried out in collaboration with the organization Deaf West Theatre, these scenes were released in celebration of National Deaf History Month.

Do you think every animated movie should include this type of animation?
title: Disney in Sign Language! (ASL)
